note: Local n8n harness done and proven. `npm run n8n:dev` (scripts/n8n-dev.mjs) builds, symlinks dist/ into .n8n-dev/custom/n8n-nodes-typesafe, and runs `npx -y n8n@2.39.8 start` with N8N_USER_FOLDER=.n8n-dev (real ~/.n8n untouched), N8N_CUSTOM_EXTENSIONS=.n8n-dev/custom, telemetry/version-notifications/personalization/templates/hiring-banner off. n8n 2.39.8 (requires Node >=24; box has 24.18.0) started clean and loaded the package with no errors. Evidence: n8n's own generated type cache .n8n-dev/.cache/n8n/public/types/nodes.json contains {"name":"CUSTOM.typeSafe","displayName":"TypeSafe AI","iconUrl":"icons/CUSTOM/n8n-nodes-typesafe/nodes/TypeSafe/typesafe.svg","credentials":[{"name":"typeSafeApi","required":true}]} (1 of 990 node types) and credentials.json contains {"name":"typeSafeApi","displayName":"TypeSafe AI API"} (1 of 520); GET /icons/CUSTOM/n8n-nodes-typesafe/nodes/TypeSafe/typesafe.svg returned 200 image/svg+xml unauthenticated. The HTTP /types/*.json routes are auth-gated in n8n 2.x (401) and no owner account was created, so the on-disk cache those routes serve was read directly. Nothing in the package needed fixing to load. One harness bug found and fixed during verification: forwarding a signal to npx alone leaves n8n running and port 5678 bound, so the child is spawned detached and the whole process group is signalled; SIGINT/SIGTERM to the script now stops n8n and the task runner and frees the port. .n8n-dev/ left in place (gitignored, ~82 MB) so US-TSN-1-5 reuses the warm npx cache and migrated sqlite. No owner account, no credential, no API key anywhere.
